name: @dsh-plugins/root
description: Custom plugin collection for DeepSeek Harness: MCP service manager and Skill manager panels, extensible to more panels.

scripts.test:zip: tsc packages/skill-panel/src/zip-import.ts packages/skill-panel/src/types.ts --outDir packages/skill-panel/.tmp-build --rootDir packages/skill-panel/src --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --allowImportingTsExtensions --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --skipLibCheck && node packages/skill-panel/test-zip-import.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:zip && pnpm run test:market
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build && HERE="$PWD" && cd "${DSH_REPO:-../deepseek-harness}" && pnpm dsh web --patch "$HERE/cordis.yml"
scripts.test:market: tsc packages/mcp-market-panel/src/client/to-config.ts packages/mcp-market-panel/src/client/slug.ts packages/mcp-market-panel/src/client/registry.ts packages/mcp-market-panel/src/client/local-catalog.ts --outDir packages/mcp-market-panel/.tmp-build --rootDir packages/mcp-market-panel/src --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --strict --allowImportingTsExtensions --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --skipLibCheck && node packages/mcp-market-panel/test-market-mapping.mjs
